name: Pretty Peculiar Lovers
source:
You play as Aidan, a new student at your high school. Aidan is uncertain and shy, but he will soon meet the four romance candidates, Kai, Ruby, Julian, and Lucy. They may seem warm and welcoming at first, but each of them may be hiding their own secrets...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756530/]Steam[/url]]
